settings.pageTitle: Ajayi Samuel — SA Imagery | Cinematographer, Videographer, Photographer
settings.description: Ajayi Samuel (SA Imagery) — cinematographer, videographer and photographer telling African stories for brands like Web3bridge, Amplify Africa and AllThings Africa.
settings.tagline: Telling African stories, one frame at a time.

hero.intro: Serious about the craft, playful behind the scenes. I shoot films, stories and stills for brands building Africa's next chapter — and when the camera's down, I'm on the pitch.

brands.title:
Trusted by brands
telling Africa's story
brands.blurb: From Web3 education to pan-African culture — Samuel leads media, shoots and cuts content for teams moving the continent forward.

about.title:
Behind
the lens
about.lead: I'm Ajayi Samuel — the eye behind SA Imagery. I'm a cinematographer, videographer and photographer who takes the work seriously and the process a little less so.
about.body: I've led media at Web3bridge and cut stories for Amplify Africa and AllThings Africa. Hand me a Sony and a deadline and I'll hand you something worth watching. Hand me a football and you've lost me for the afternoon.

facts.label: Off duty
facts.value: On the pitch — or watching Arsenal

services.title: What I do
services.blurb: Four crafts, one eye. Book them on their own or bring me in end-to-end — from the first frame to the final export.

items.title: Cinematography
items.description: Cinematic brand films, documentaries and event films — lit, framed and graded to feel like cinema.

items.title: Videography
items.description: Clean, reliable coverage for conferences, interviews and campaigns — captured on time, every time.

items.title: Photography
items.description: Portraits, events and editorial stills with real character — the moments between the moments.

items.title: Video editing
items.description: Story-first edits with colour and sound, for long-form and short-form, from rough cut to delivery.

work.title: Selected work
work.blurb: Brand films, event coverage, edits and stills. Full project links are on the way — this reel is loading.

gear.title:
The kit behind
the frame
gear.body: A Sony shooter through and through. Light, fast kit that moves with the story — on set, on stage or on the sideline.
